entrance: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 16:9 finished game consequence illustration, no panels or UI. Reference 1 is immutable STYLE: luminous soft narrative hand drawn 2D, cream architecture, pale blue gray floor, soft colored shadows, thin colored contours, matte surfaces. NO haze, washed out opacity, glossy plastic or photorealism. Reference 2 is the SAME warehouse layout: receiving LEFT, dispatch RIGHT, blue steel orange beam racks, tall windows, gray floor yellow lanes. Reference 3 is exact boat cargo and trolley identity and family rendering: folded dark blue inflatable boat with orange handles and orange paddle strapped on top, secured gray outboard beside it, on blue flatbed four caster trolley. Keep its physical size roughly 1.5m and all identifiers, not a gift box. Reference 4 is authoritative uniform construction: hooded long winter jacket orange front chest panels and shoulders, navy sleeves and broad central placket, navy chest band and both pocket flaps, navy lower jacket. Silver SHORT shoulder tabs, TWO silver bands on each sleeve (elbow and wrist). FRONT: silver waist line and hem line interrupted by navy central placket. BACK different: orange shoulder yoke, navy separator, silver upper-back short band, orange logo panel, plain navy lower back WITHOUT silver waist/hem bands. Orange trouser thighs, navy knees/calves, single silver calf band edged thin red. Black boots. White corporate chest mark wearer left; Russian flag right sleeve, industry patch left sleeve. No red edges on jacket. Clothing accuracy is critical. Character head and full cargo remain visible. No extraneous people, symbols, annotations or text except required spatial signage. SCENARIO ENTRANCE: gift placed in first available receiving rack makes collection take a long detour when dispatch is ready. Show receiving end in foreground LEFT with readable door sign "ПРИЁМКА" and rack "Ю–Я". Give long perspective route across warehouse to dispatch, with intervening rack runs. Push handle behind cargo, worker LEFT of trolley, cargo moves RIGHT. Make this unmistakably the far receiving end, not middle alphabet shelf. No diagrams/arrows. Medium-wide enough for full worker and boat in central area. Preserve boat and uniform perfectly.
